::: {#exm-tree-edges}
#### Counting edges

- The pipes tree of @exm-pipes-tree has 7 vertices and 6 edges,
  and the phone tree of @exm-phone-tree has 8 vertices and 7 edges, as @thm-tree-edges says.
- Each connected component of the forest $F$ of @exm-forest is a tree,
  with 1, 1, 2 and 4 vertices, so it has 0, 0, 1 and 3 edges.
  $F$ has 8 vertices and $0 + 0 + 1 + 3 = 4$ edges.
- The graph $H$ of @fig-trees-or-not is connected and has 5 vertices and 5 edges,
  so it is not a tree, by @thm-tree-edges, without finding its cycle.

:::
